title: The Truth about the "Oxymoron" Sovereign-Citizen!
summary: Debunker traces the 'sovereign citizen' label to Posse Comitatus, Roger Elvick's redemption theory and 1990s seminars, rebutting the claim that adherents never used it.

assertions.quote: Posse Comitatus actually started this entire movement
there's secret squirrel accounts out there which is actually not true
you could have bills written off through the Treasury so on and so forth none of it being true of course
that is why today you hear of the redemption theory being something that they teach in prisons across the nation
they did actually self proclaimed themselves with that name

verdicts.note: 1990s seminars and books by movement figures used 'sovereign citizen' as a self-description before it became pejorative.
